scope: Same three V13 immediately-alighted waiting states, full platform actions, station-declared MCT, fixed deadline loss and local occurrence information. Reuse development posterior only.

population.J: Frozen V13 first_visible with the same published policy and incumbent.
population.V_star: Full causal optimum with no advance knowledge of any realized future.
population.V_R: Reveal all other trip chains at the root; named A and B still have their original conditional laws. Continue until the actual journey deadline.
population.V_R_tau: Same R revelation and original V13 stop rule (first ride completion or 720 elapsed seconds), then clairvoyant continuation.
population.ell_4: Expected V13 4×4 empirical optimum over independent A/B atoms and an independent common rest realization.

original_product_panel.tapes: All eight original outer banks per root. Check every event-driven prefix optimum against the saved unit-tick V13 optimum.
original_product_panel.full_deadline: All 16 combinations in the original product bank, with R known and no earlier clairvoyant tail. A completed empirical solve is one lower observation for V_R, not the fitted-law optimum.
original_product_panel.feasible_relaxed_policies: First_visible to the V13 boundary then use the same clairvoyant tail for the V_R_tau relaxation. For V_R use a feasible rest-only path given revealed rest, with a predeclared switch to first_visible if its loss exceeds 900/500/850 seconds by root. Save the rest-only path and its loss separately.
original_product_panel.larger_inner: Append four independently generated A and B atoms to each original 4×4 bank. Solve the same prefix on 8×8. Compare its estimator to original 4×4 at common R. Larger-bank monotonicity holds in expectation by the subsample inequality, not necessarily for an individual paired draw.

whole_iid_panel.tapes: Split the original 64 independent full-world draws into eight fixed non-overlapping groups of eight per root.
whole_iid_panel.solver: Full causal empirical optimum, no R label or early clairvoyant tail, on each group. Evaluate the original first_visible on the same rows. The empirical optimum is optimistic on average and gives a population lower observation.

declared_finite_populations: Cross two A, two B and two rest draws per declared block. Solve J, full causal, root-rest revealed, revealed with original stopping rule, and the exact expectation of the 4×4 empirical estimator by enumerating the binomial atom counts. Do not substitute this smaller law for the frozen fitted population.
budget: Use 50,000 information nodes per main-bank solve. A budget exit returns no partial optimum. Predefined lower substitutes are the matched full clairvoyant mean or, for original product full deadline, the completed same-bank original V13 prefix. Costs are offline diagnostic costs.
exact_solver: Collapse quiet WAIT ticks to the earliest possible public event across current support. Complete a singleton only when a verified executable itinerary attains the relaxed scan. A common causal policy attaining every world's scan or a feasible policy attaining the original prefix lower value certifies equality. Otherwise use exact event DP with admissible action pruning. The original V13 prefix is verified at all 24 banks before reusing these results.
inference: Outer banks are the independent units for paired bounds. Use ordered endpoints and simultaneous confidence; do not subtract two lower estimates to infer a population component. Use the documented support range, not observed extrema.
